verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-sharing and remote-control app, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions an MCP server or any agent-facing interface, and probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI both returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
